WITH fan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        f.userregistry,
        f.nicklabel,
        m.membdays,
        e.actfreq,
        e.engrate,
        e.socintscore,
        e.actdayswk,
        e.avgsesscount,
        sc.collabcount,
        sc.community_engagement->'network'->>'follcount'::numeric as follcount,
        sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'contqualrate'::numeric as contqualrate,
        sc.community_engagement->'content_creation'->>'ugcval'::numeric as ugcval,
        r.viralcont,
        sc.community_engagement->'group_involvement'->>'grprole' as grprole
    FROM fans f
    JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.userregistry = m.memberfanpivot
    JOIN engagement e ON m.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
    JOIN socialcommunity sc ON e.engagereg = sc.socialengagepivot
    JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON e.engagereg = r.retainengagepivot
),
scores AS (
    SELECT 
        userregistry,
        nicklabel,
        membdays,
        actfreq,
        grprole,
        -- FEI
        (engrate * 0.4) + ((socintscore / 100.0) * 0.3) + ((actdayswk / 7.0) * 0.2) + ((avgsesscount / 10.0) * 0.1) as fei,
        -- CCIS
        contqualrate * (ugcval / 10.0) * (1.0 + (COALESCE(follcount, 0) / 100.0) * 0.5) as ccis,
        -- SIM
        (COALESCE(follcount, 0) / 100.0) * (engrate * 2) * ((COALESCE(viralcont, 0)) + 1) * 0.5 as sim,
        collabcount
    FROM fan_data
)
SELECT 
    nicklabel,
    ROUND(CAST((ccis * 0.4 + sim * 0.3 + collabcount * 0.1 + fei * 0.2) AS numeric), 2) as cci_score,
    grprole,
    actfreq,
    membdays
FROM scores
WHERE (ccis * 0.4 + sim * 0.3 + collabcount * 0.1 + fei * 0.2) > 7
    AND actfreq = 'Daily'
    AND membdays > 180
    AND grprole IN ('Moderator', 'Leader')
ORDER BY cci_score DESC;
